 UVA Basketball: #9 ‘Hoos set to host Northeastern on Friday at JPJ
 Chris Graham
 Published date: 
 November 5, 2026 | 8:23 pm
 Updated:

 Sam Lewis. Photo: Mike Ingalls/AFP 
 The UVA Basketball team already has one win in CAA play, with its 89-60 victory over Drexel on Tuesday.
 On Friday, the ninth-ranked ‘Hoos can get to 2-0 against the Conference Formerly Known as the Colonial with Northeastern coming to JPJ.
 Drexel was picked ninth in the CAA in the preseason poll of the league’s coaches; Northeastern was picked to finish 11th .
 Details
 #9 Virginia (1-0) vs. Northeastern (0-1) 
 Tipoff : Friday, 5 p.m.
 TV : ACC Network
 The Huskies do have one guy who made the All-CAA preseason team – Rashad King , a grad-student guard.
 King had 21 points (8-of-14 FG, 1-of-7 3FG) in 29 minutes in Northeastern’s 93-85 loss to Boston U. on Monday.
 King, a big guard, at 6’6”, 204, is an interesting story – he was at Northeastern for three years, averaging 18.5 points per game in the 2024-2025 season, before transferring to LSU for his senior season; he averaged 5.8 points per game there as a rotation piece in 2025-2026 .
 He’s back for a fifth year after winning a court injunction.
 Dorian Grosber , a 6’6” sophomore, had 18 points (6-of-14 FG, 3-of-7 3FG) in the season opener.
 Brayden Young , a 6’10” sophomore who transferred in from Loyola-Chicago , had 13 points and four boards .
 The rotation has size – everybody is 6’4” or bigger .
 Didn’t rebound well in the loss to Boston U. – with a 60.0% defensive rebound rate and a 22.6% offensive rebound rate .
 Didn’t shoot well from three (6-of-23, 26.1%), but got the ball to the rim (8-of-10, 80.0%) and into the lane (16-of-22, 72.7%).
